name: Song ad
what: A person sings (or lip-syncs) a short, catchy jingle about the problem and the product, to camera, with the product in hand. Earworm first; the claim is in the lyric.

beats.does: the first sung line names the problem in the customer's words, on a beat drop
two sung lines: what the product does, shown in use
the catch line, sung twice, holding the product to camera

lyric_rules: 4-6 short lines, end-rhymes, each line 4-8 words, built only from the language bank's phrases and the banked claims; the product name sung once
camera: phone selfie or locked tripod, performer centred, cut to the product on the chorus
sound: the take sings with its own audio at the test tier; a winner is re-made with the song route in the model house before upscale
variation_axes: genre (trap, R&B, pop-punk, country, gospel, k-pop, sea shanty)
